spots.name: The Waves and the City
spots.blurb: You've reached The Waves and the City, a mural by Aili Zhang. It shows landscape. Mural created using natural materials collected in Beppu, reflecting the city's landscape and spirit. Part of the Beppu Project.

spots.name: Scene
spots.blurb: You've reached Scene, a mural by Yasuhide Kunimoto from 2015. Wall painting depicting the appearance of people who gather in Beppu, intersect, and spread.

spots.name: Untitled
spots.blurb: You've reached Untitled, a mural by HITOTZUKI from 2015. It shows Beppu cityscape. Wall mural inspired by Beppu, expressing coexistence of old and new city elements.

spots.name: Evidence Clouds
spots.blurb: You've reached Evidence Clouds, a mural by HITOTZUKI from 2015. It shows Beppu cityscape. Wall mural inspired by the city of Beppu, blending traces of old and new development.

tours.name: 北浜 Walk
tours.desc: Evidence Clouds to Scene · about 0.7 km
